```{r}
#Data set (Eggs and potential covatiates) 
data.eggs <- read_xlsx("data/data_glmm.xlsx",na = c("NA"))
data.eggs<- data.eggs %>% mutate(station = factor(station))

data.eggs <- add_utm_columns(data.eggs, c("lon", "lat"), ll_crs = "WGS84", utm_crs = 32635,  units = "km") #Project coordinates to km
data.eggs$time<- as.integer(data.eggs$Year)  
data.eggs$Year <- as.factor(data.eggs$Year)
data.eggs <- data.eggs %>% dplyr::rename("SSS"="sal00_2to7m" )
data.eggs <- data.eggs %>% dplyr::rename("SST"="t090_2to7m" )
data.eggs <- data.eggs %>%dplyr::rename("Depth"="bottom_depth" )
```
str(data.eggs)
tibble [856 × 15] (S3: tbl_df/tbl/data.frame)
 $ Year           : YEAR OF SAMPLING
 $ station        : STATION NUMBER
 $ lon            : Sampling Lon in deg
 $ lat            : Sampling Lat in deg
 $ eggs0_abu      : Egg0/m2 
 $ sal00_2to7m    : CTD Salinity (measured + interpolated values) at 2-7m (mean)
 $ t090_2to7m     : CTD Temperature (measured + interpolated values) at 2-7m (mean)
 $ CTD            : CTD mesurment-YES ; Interpolation-NO
 $ bottom_depth   : Depth of the sea-bead (mesured)
 $ TL_cm          : Annual mean TL (in cm)
 $ Acoustic_Biomas: Biomass from acoustic method (in t)
 $ CHL_extracted  : CHl-a concentration L4 satelite
 $ X              : Sampling Lon in Km
 $ Y              : Sampling Lat in Km
 $ time           : time step for spatio-temporal filed


```{r}
#Data for maps

#Cosatline
coast <- st_read("data/Greece_geology/Greece/land_poly_GR.gpkg",quiet = TRUE) %>%  st_transform(crs = "WGS84")
coast_km<-  st_transform(coast, crs = 32635);  
st_geometry(coast_km) <- st_geometry(coast_km) / 1000  

#Rivers
rivers <- st_read("data/Greece_geology/Rivers/Rivers_geodatagovgr/Rivers_geodatagovgr.shp",quiet = TRUE)  %>% st_transform(crs = "WGS84")  %>%  
  filter(ALTNAME1 %in% c("EVROS R. 1", "EVROS R. 2","NESTOS R.","STRYMONIKOU S","STRYMON R. 2","STRYMON R. 1","AXIOS R. (VARDARIS)","ALIAKMON R.","ALIAKMON R. 1","ALIAKMON R. 2","PINIOS R.", "AXIOS R. (VARDARIS)"))  

#Isobaths
isobath <- st_read("data/Greece_geology/Isobaths/ged_med_bathymetry/countour_gebmed.shp",quiet = TRUE) %>% filter(CONTOUR %in% c(-200,-100))#,-50)) #subset contours 200m
isobath_type <- c("-100" = 5,"-200"= 1) ; isobath$Isobaths<-  as.factor(isobath$CONTOUR)
isobath.km<-  st_transform(isobath, crs = 32635);  st_geometry(isobath.km) <- st_geometry(isobath.km) / 1000 
```

## Egg0 data exploration (Figure 2)
``` {r} 
# Split data into zeros and positives
eggs_zero <- filter(data.eggs, eggs0_abu == 0)
eggs_pos  <- filter(data.eggs, eggs0_abu > 0)

# Define legend breaks based on your data
breaks <- c(0.1, 1, 10, 100, 500, 1000, 2325)
labels <- c("0", "1", "10", "100",500, "1000", "2325")

#MAP
plot_eggs <- ggplot() +
  # Coastline
  geom_sf(data = coast, fill = "gray60", col = "gray50") +
  
  # Rivers
  geom_sf(data = rivers, col = "steelblue", lwd = 0.5) +
  
  # Isobaths
  geom_sf(data = isobath, aes(linetype = factor(Isobaths)),
          col = "gray40", lwd = 0.2) +
  scale_linetype_manual(name = "Isobaths (m)",values = c("-100" = "solid", "-200" = "dotdash")) +
  
  # Zeros as gray circles
  geom_point(data = eggs_zero, aes(x = lon, y = lat),
             color = "grey50", fill = "grey50",
             size = 1, alpha = 0.8, shape = 21) +
  
  # Positive values: size + color mapped
  geom_point(data = eggs_pos,
             aes(x = lon, y = lat, size = eggs0_abu, color = eggs0_abu),
             alpha = 0.8) +

  scale_size_continuous(
    trans = "log10",
    range = c(1, 3),
    breaks = breaks,   # exclude 0 for log scale
    labels = labels,
    name =expression(eggs[0]~m^{-2}))  +
  
  scale_color_viridis_c(
    trans = "log10",
    breaks = breaks,
    labels = labels,
    na.value = "grey50",
    name =expression(eggs[0]~m^{-2})) +
  
  # Legend: show zeros as gray
  guides(
    size = guide_legend(override.aes = list(color = viridis(length(breaks) - 2))),
    color = "none",
    linetype = guide_legend(order = 2)) +
  
  # Facet by year
  facet_wrap(~ Year) +
  coord_sf(xlim = c(23.5, 26.4), ylim = c(39.2, 41.1)) +
  labs(x = "Longitude", y = "Latitude") +
  theme_bw()+
 scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(23, 26, by = 1))+ theme(legend.position = "right",    legend.justification = "top",
            legend.title = element_text(size = 10),  # smaller title
            legend.text = element_text(size = 8),    # smaller labels,
  #legend.margin = margin(t = 15),
  legend.box.spacing = unit(0.5, "cm"),
  plot.margin = margin(12, 1, 5, 10),
  strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = "white"),  strip.text.x = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11,hjust = 0) )


#Boxplot
N_data_eggs <- data.eggs %>% select( "Year","eggs0_abu") |>
  dplyr::group_by(Year) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    N = n(),
    Zero = sum(eggs0_abu == 0),
    Zero_percent = 100 * Zero / N)

boxplot <- ggplot(data.eggs%>% filter(eggs0_abu>0), aes(x = as.factor(Year), y = eggs0_abu)) + 
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.8, color = "gray20",outlier.size = 0.5) +
  geom_point(
  data =N_data_eggs,
    aes(x = Year, y = -80, size = Zero_percent),
    shape = 21,
    fill = "#D95F02",
    colour = "gray20",
    alpha = 0.8 ) +
  scale_size_continuous(name = ("% Zeros"), range =c(0.6,1.8)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-80, NA))+
  ggtitle(expression(eggs[0]~m^{-2})) +  xlab("") + 
  ylab("") +  theme_bw(base_size =9)+ 
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 40, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "right" )
 
# Combine maps and boxplot 
final_data <- ggdraw() +
  draw_plot(plot_eggs) +
  inset_element(
    boxplot,
    left   = 0.59,  # close to left edge
    bottom = -0.04,  # close to bottom edge
    right  = 1.0,  # inset width (increase for bigger inset)
    top    = 0.34,  # inset height (increase for taller inset)
    align_to = "full")

final_data
```

## Covariates exploration (Figures S2-S6)

#### Depth Figure S2  
```{r}
map_depth <- ggplot() +
 
  geom_sf(data = coast, fill = "gray60", col = "gray50") +
 
  geom_sf(data = rivers, col = "steelblue", lwd = 0.5) +
  
  geom_sf(data = isobath, aes(linetype = factor(Isobaths)), col = "gray40", lwd = 0.2) +
   scale_linetype_manual(
    name = "Isobaths (m)",
    values = c("-100" = "solid", "-200" = "dotdash")) +
  
 geom_point(data = data.eggs,
             aes(x = lon, y = lat, color = Depth),
             alpha = 0.9) +
  
 facet_wrap(~Year) +
 
  scale_color_gradientn(
  colors = grDevices::colorRampPalette(
    rev(c("#081d58", "#253494", "#225ea8", "#1d91c0",
          "#41b6c4", "#7fcdbb", "#c7e9b4", "#ffffcc")))(300),
  name = "Depth (m)",
  trans = "log",
  labels = scales::label_number(accuracy = 1)) +  
  coord_sf(xlim = c(23.5, 26.4), ylim = c(39.2, 41.1)) +
  labs(x = "Longitude", y = "Latitude") +
  theme_bw()+
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(23, 26, by = 1)) + 
  theme( legend.position = "bottom",     # put legend below
         legend.title = element_text(size = 10),  # smaller title
         legend.text = element_text(size = 8),    # smaller labels,
         legend.box.spacing = unit(0.5, "cm"),
         plot.margin = margin(12, 1, 5, 10),
         strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = "white"),  # white background with black border
         strip.text.x = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11,hjust = 0)) 

# Boxplot Depth 
data.eggs$Depth_std <- scale(data.eggs$Depth)

# Get ranges
y_min  <- min(data.eggs$Depth, na.rm = TRUE)
y_max  <- max(data.eggs$Depth, na.rm = TRUE)
std_min <- min(data.eggs$Depth_std, na.rm = TRUE)
std_max <- max(data.eggs$Depth_std, na.rm = TRUE)

# Define linear transformation between raw and standardized scales
to_std <- function(x) (x - y_min) / (y_max - y_min) * (std_max - std_min) + std_min

cruise_means <- data.eggs %>%
  group_by(Year) %>%
  summarise(mean_depth = mean(Depth, na.rm = TRUE))

# Get min and max salinity for scaling
depth_range <- range(data.eggs$Depth, na.rm = TRUE)

# Plot sd and normal
Depth_box<- ggplot(data.eggs, aes(y = as.factor(Year), x = Depth)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.8, color = "gray20",outlier.size = 0.5) +
  scale_x_continuous(
   name = "Depth (m)",
    sec.axis = sec_axis(~ to_std(.), name = "z-Depth")) +
  xlab("") + ylab("") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        axis.text.y = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        plot.background  = element_rect(fill = NA, colour = NA),
       legend.background = element_rect(fill = NA, colour = NA)  )


#Combine the two maps
final_Depth <- ggdraw() +
  draw_plot(map_depth) +
  inset_element(
    Depth_box,
    left   = 0.655,  # close to left edge
    bottom = 0.08,  # close to bottom edge
    right  = 1.01,  # inset width (increase for bigger inset)
    top    = 0.425,  # inset height (increase for taller inset)
    align_to = "full")

final_Depth
```

#### Salinity Figure S3 
```{r}
#Plot standardized Salinity 
data.eggs$SSS_std <- scale(data.eggs$SSS)

# Get ranges
y_min  <- min(data.eggs$SSS, na.rm = TRUE)
y_max  <- max(data.eggs$SSS, na.rm = TRUE)
std_min <- min(data.eggs$SSS_std, na.rm = TRUE)
std_max <- max(data.eggs$SSS_std, na.rm = TRUE)

# Define linear transformation between raw and standardized scales
to_std <- function(x) (x - y_min) / (y_max - y_min) * (std_max - std_min) + std_min

# Plot sd and normal
Salinity_Box<- ggplot(data.eggs, aes(x = as.factor(Year), y = SSS)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.8, color = "gray20",outlier.size = 0.5) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = "SSS (psu)",
    sec.axis = sec_axis(~ to_std(.), name = "z-SSS")) +
  xlab("") + ylab("") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))


plots <- lapply(split(data.eggs, data.eggs$Year), function(df) {
    ggplot() +
        geom_sf(data = coast, fill = "gray60", col = "gray50") +
        geom_sf(data = rivers, col = "steelblue", lwd = 0.5) +
        geom_sf(data = isobath, aes(linetype = factor(Isobaths)),
          col = "gray40", lwd = 0.2, show.legend = FALSE)+  # <-- hides the legend for this layer) +
    scale_linetype_manual( name = "Isobaths (m)",values = c("-100" = "solid", "-200" = "dotdash")) +

# CTD = NO
geom_point(
      data = subset(df, CTD == "NO"),
      aes(x = lon, y = lat, fill = SSS),
      shape = 21,
      alpha = 0.9,colour = "gray60",stroke = 0.1) +

# CTD = YES
geom_point(
      data = subset(df, CTD == "YES"),
      aes(x = lon, y = lat, fill = SSS),
      shape = 21,
      colour = "black",stroke = 0.18, alpha = 0.9 ) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
            colors = grDevices::colorRampPalette(
             c("#2166ac", "#67a9cf", "#d1e5f0", "#fddbc7", "#ef8a62", "#b2182b"))(300),
         name = "SSS\n(psu)")+        
  coord_sf(xlim = c(23.5, 26.4), ylim = c(39.2, 41.1)) +
  labs( title = unique(df$Year),
        x = "Longitude", y = "Latitude") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(23, 26, by = 1)) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme( plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11,hjust = 0), # right-aligned
         legend.position = "bottom",     # put legend below
          legend.title = element_text(size = 8),  # smaller title
          legend.text = element_text(size = 8),    # smaller labels
          legend.key.width = unit(0.5, "cm"),       # make colorbar wider
          legend.key.height = unit(0.3, "cm"),     # make colorbar shorter
  legend.box.margin = margin(t = 0, b = 1, l = 0, r = 0))  # moves legend closer to panel
  })

final_plot <- wrap_plots(plots)


final_Sal <- ggdraw() +
  draw_plot(final_plot) +
  inset_element(
    Salinity_Box,
    left   = 0.655,  # close to left edge
    bottom =  0,  # close to bottom edge
    right  = 1,  # inset width (increase for bigger inset)
    top    = 0.35,  # inset height (increase for taller inset)
    align_to = "full")

final_Sal
```

#### CHLA Figure S6 
```{r}
#Plot standardized Chl-a 
data.eggs$CHL_extracted_std <- scale(data.eggs$CHL_extracted)

# Get ranges
y_min  <- min(data.eggs$CHL_extracted, na.rm = TRUE)
y_max  <- max(data.eggs$CHL_extracted, na.rm = TRUE)
std_min <- min(data.eggs$CHL_extracted_std, na.rm = TRUE)
std_max <- max(data.eggs$CHL_extracted_std, na.rm = TRUE)

# Define linear transformation between raw and standardized scales
to_std <- function(x) (x - y_min) / (y_max - y_min) * (std_max - std_min) + std_min

# Plot sd and normal
CHL_Box<- ggplot(data.eggs, aes(x = as.factor(Year), y = CHL_extracted)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.8, color = "gray20",outlier.size = 0.5) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = expression(Chla-a ~(mg ~m^{-3})),
    sec.axis = sec_axis(~ to_std(.), name = "z-Chl-a")) +
  xlab("") + ylab("") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

plots <- lapply(split(data.eggs, data.eggs$Year), function(df) {
  ggplot() +
    geom_sf(data = coast, fill = "gray60",col = "gray50") +
    geom_sf(data = rivers,col = "steelblue",lwd = 0.5) +
    geom_sf(data = isobath, aes(linetype = factor(Isobaths)), col = "gray40", lwd = 0.2, show.legend = FALSE) +
    scale_linetype_manual(
      name = "Isobaths (m)",
      values = c(  "-100" = "solid","-200" = "dotdash")) +
  geom_point(
      data = df,
      aes(x = lon, y = lat,color = CHL_extracted),
      alpha = 0.9) +
    scale_color_gradientn(
      colors = grDevices::colorRampPalette(
        c("#f7fcf5","#e5f5e0","#c7e9c0","#a1d99b","#74c476","#41ab5d","#238b45","#006d2c","#00441b"))(300),
     name = expression(atop(Chl-a, (mg~m^{-3}))) ) +
    
  coord_sf(xlim = c(23.5, 26.4),  ylim = c(39.2, 41.1)) +
  labs(
     title = unique(df$Year),
      x = "Longitude",  y = "Latitude") +
  scale_x_continuous (breaks = seq(23, 26, by = 1)) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold",size = 11,hjust = 0),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.title = element_text(size = 8),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 8),
      legend.key.width = unit(0.5, "cm"),
      legend.key.height = unit(0.3, "cm"),
      legend.box.margin = margin(t = 0,b = 1,l = 0,r = 0))
})

final_plot <- wrap_plots(plots)

final_CHL <- ggdraw() +
  draw_plot(final_plot) +
  inset_element(
    CHL_Box,
    left   = 0.66,  # close to left edge
    bottom =  0,  # close to bottom edge
    right  = 1,  # inset width (increase for bigger inset)
    top    = 0.35,  # inset height (increase for taller inset)
    align_to = "full")

final_CHL
```

### Covariates Collinearity exploration  
```{r}
# Annual means 
mean_TL<- data.eggs %>%
  group_by(Year) %>%
  summarise(TL = mean(TL_cm, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  arrange(Year)

mean_SSS<- data.eggs %>%
  group_by(Year) %>%
  summarise(SSS = mean(SSS, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  arrange(Year)

mean_SST<- data.eggs %>%
```

## Standardize you data covariates before the models
```{r}
data.eggs <- data.eggs %>%
  mutate(across(c("SSS","Depth","SST","TL_cm","Acoustic_Biomas","CHL_extracted"), ~ scale(.)[, 1]))
```

## Create the mesh

The characteristics of the mesh have been decided based on a prior sensitivity analysis. 
We thank M.Woillez for providing us a tutor code fo how to implement barrier mesh. 
The following code is a modified for the current application in the NEAS.

```{r}
poly.coast <- coast  # Greek shp WGS84
stations_sf <- st_as_sf(data.eggs, coords = c("lon","lat"), crs = 4326)
plot(stations_sf$geometry, pch=19, col=2)

# Create a convex hull polygon around all stations
transect_poly <- st_convex_hull(st_union(stations_sf))

# Buffer around the transect polygon (e.g., 0.1 degrees ~ ~10km depending on latitude)
buff <- st_buffer(transect_poly, dist = 10000)  # WGS84 degrees; or use UTM for meters

# Plot the buffer
plot(buff, col = "lightblue", border = "blue")
plot(stations_sf$geometry, add = TRUE, pch = 19, col = 2)
 
output = st_intersection(buff,poly.coast)
plot(output,col=3)
domain = st_difference(transect_poly,st_union(output))
domain = st_sf(domain)

domain_utm <- st_transform(domain, "+init=epsg:32635 +units=km")
plot(domain_utm,col=4,axes=T)
plot(data.eggs$X, data.eggs$Y, pch="+",add=T)

# build the mesh with coastline
range_est<- (23*1.85) # Decided based on the prior sensitivity analysis 

max.edge =range_est/5 #max.edge is smaller than 1/5 of the range #max.edge:  8.51 km
bound.outer = range_est*(2/3) #bound.outer   28.36667 km

mesh_high = inla.mesh.2d(
                         boundary = domain_utm,
                         loc = cbind(data.eggs$X, data.eggs$Y),
                         max.edge = c(1,5)*max.edge,
                         cutoff = max.edge/5,
                         offset = c(max.edge, bound.outer)
                         )
plot(mesh_high, lwd=0.5, axes = T); points(data.eggs$X, data.eggs$Y, col="red")
mesh_high <- make_mesh(data.eggs, c("X", "Y"), mesh = mesh_high)
plot(mesh_high, lwd=0.5, axes = T); points(data.eggs$X, data.eggs$Y, col="red")

# Add on the barrier mesh component
poly.coast_utm <- st_transform(poly.coast, "+init=epsg:32635 +units=km")
bspde <- add_barrier_mesh(
  spde_obj = mesh_high,
  barrier_sf = poly.coast_utm,
  range_fraction = 0.1,
  proj_scaling = 1,
  plot = TRUE)

plot(bspde, lwd=0.5); points(data.eggs$X, data.eggs$Y, col="red")

#We can make a more advanced plot if we want:
mesh_df_water <- bspde$mesh_sf[bspde$normal_triangles, ]
mesh_df_land <- bspde$mesh_sf[bspde$barrier_triangles, ]

xlims2 <- c(200,400)
ylims2 <- c(4350,4550)

ggplot(poly.coast_utm) +
  geom_sf() +
  geom_sf(data = mesh_df_water, size = .1, colour = "blue") +
  geom_sf(data = mesh_df_land, size = .1, colour = "green") +
  coord_sf(xlim = xlims2, ylim = ylims2)
  
triangles <- bspde$mesh$graph$tv
coords <- bspde$mesh$loc[, 1:2]
triangle_centroids <- apply(triangles, 1, function(verts) {
  colMeans(coords[verts, ])
})
centroids_df <- data.frame(
  X = triangle_centroids[1, ],
  Y = triangle_centroids[2, ])

# Mark land/water
centroids_df$region <- "water"
centroids_df$region[bspde$barrier_triangles] <- "land"

plot(bspde, lwd = 0.5);points(centroids_df$X, centroids_df$Y, col = ifelse(centroids_df$region=="water","blue","green"), pch = 19, cex = 0.5) ;points(data.eggs$X, data.eggs$Y, col = "red", pch = 16)
```
## Instert prediction grid

We are going to need another grid in which we will predict the eggs abundance using the final model.

The prediction grid needs to have all the variables that were used in the model in each of each cell every year.
Here I am just predicting back in the initial locations because I just want to visualize my spatial fields

```{r}
pred_grid= data.eggs
```

# Spatiotemporal model without covariates 
### Model fit 
```{r}
fit_m0 <- sdmTMB(
 eggs0_abu ~ 1 + (1|Year),
  data = data.eggs,
  mesh = bspde,
  family = tweedie (link = "log"),
  spatial = "on",
  spatiotemporal = "IID",   
  time = "time")
```

### Diagnostics
```{r}
sanity(fit_m0)
```

### Results of the fit
```{r}
fit_m0
```
### Residual cheking 
```{r}
model=fit_m0
  # Simulate and calculate residuals
  s_fit_m0 <- simulate(model, nsim = 1000, type = "mle-mvn")
  r_fit_m0 <- dharma_residuals(s_fit_m0, model, return_DHARMa = TRUE)
  
# Run DHARMa tests
# QQ
 qq_plot_m0<- as.ggplot(~{ 
  plotQQunif(r_fit_m0,testUniformity = F, testOutliers = F, testDispersion = F)
 }) 

#Residuals vs predicted
DHARMa::plotResiduals(r_fit_m0)

#Check you models ability to catch Zeros
sum(data.eggs$eggs0_abu== 0) / length(data.eggs$eggs0_abu) # True zero 
sum(s_fit_m0 == 0)/length(s_fit_m0) # Model fitted zero 

#Spatial autocorrelation
simulationOutputS_m0 <- recalculateResiduals(
    r_fit_m0,
    group = paste(data.eggs$X, data.eggs$Y),
    aggregateBy = mean)
  
DHARMa::testSpatialAutocorrelation(
    simulationOutputS_m0,
    x = unique(data.eggs$X),
    y = unique(data.eggs$Y))
 
```

### Prediction
#### Full model prediction (All fixed and random effects)
``` {r} 
#Create a prediction function to use everywhere
plot_prediction <- function(prediction,m_code) {

     # Compute values directly from exp(est)
     exp_est <- exp(prediction$est)
     max_val <- max(exp_est, na.rm = TRUE)
     min_val <- min(exp_est, na.rm = TRUE)
     sigma_val <- median(exp_est, na.rm = TRUE)  # adaptive sigma
     
     # Quantile-based breaks (10 quantiles)
     q_breaks <- quantile(exp_est, probs = seq(0, 1, length.out = 5), na.rm = TRUE)
     
     # Rounded labels to nearest 10
     q_labels <- scales::label_number(accuracy = 10, big.mark = ",")(q_breaks)
     
# The plot
ggplot() +
     geom_sf(data = coast, fill = "gray60", col = "gray50") +
     geom_sf(data = rivers, col = "steelblue", lwd = 0.5) +
     geom_sf(data = isobath, aes(linetype = factor(Isobaths)),
          col = "gray40", lwd = 0.2) +
    scale_linetype_manual(
    name = "Isobaths (m)",
    values = c("-100" = "solid", "-200" = "dotdash") ) +
         # Prediction points
         geom_point(
             data = prediction,
             aes(x = lon, y = lat, size = exp(est), color = exp(est)),
             alpha = 0.8
         ) +
         
         # Pseudo-log color scale with more quantile breaks
         scale_color_viridis_c(
            trans = scales::pseudo_log_trans(sigma = sigma_val),
             limits = c(0, max_val),
             breaks = c(0,10,50,100,200,500,1500),
             labels = c(0,10,50,100,200,500,1500),
        name =expression(eggs[0]~m^{-2})
         ) +
         
         # Pseudo-log size scale (legend hidden)
         scale_size_continuous(
             trans = scales::pseudo_log_trans(sigma = sigma_val),
             limits = c(0, max_val),
             range = c(0.1, 3),
             guide = "none"
         ) +
     
   facet_wrap(~ Year) +
  coord_sf(xlim = c(23.5, 26), ylim = c(39.3, 41)) +
  labs(x = "Longitude", y = "Latitude") +
  theme_bw()+
 scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(23.5, 26.5, by = 1))+
        ggtitle(paste(m_code))+
         theme_bw() +
         theme(legend.position = "right")}
#M0 prediction
#Predict in the prediction grid that has been created above
pred_m0 <- predict(fit_m0, newdata = pred_grid)
plotP0<- plot_prediction(pred_m0,"M0")
plotP0
```

## Model comparison 
```{r}
models <- list(M0 = fit_m0,
               M1 = fit_m1,
               M2 = fit_m2,
               M3 = fit_m3,
               M4 = fit_m4,
               M_SST = fit_m_SSS_SST,
               M_CHLA = fit_mChla)
                 
model_cov<- data.frame( model= c("M0","M1","M2","M3", "M4", "M_SST", "M_CHLA"),
                        model_candidates= 
                              c("(1|Year)+ ω + ε",
                                "(1|Year)+ ω + ε + s(Depth)",
                                "(1|Year)+ ω + ε + s(Depth) + SSS",
                                "(1|Year)+ ω + ε + s(Depth) + SSS + Acoustic_svc",
                                "          ω + ε + s(Depth) + SSS + Acoustic_svc ",
                                "(1|Year)+ ω + ε + s(Depth) + SSS + SST",
                                "(1|Year)+ ω + ε + s(Depth) + Chla"))

AIC_df <- tibble(
  model = names(models),
  AIC = sapply(models, AIC)
) %>% mutate(ΔAIC = AIC - min(AIC))


cAIC_df <- tibble(
    model = names(models),
    cAIC = sapply(models, function(m) {
     out <- cAIC(m)
     if (is.list(out)) out$caic else out
     })
    ) %>% mutate(ΔcAIC = cAIC - min(cAIC))


ran_pars_df <- bind_rows(
  lapply(names(models), function(nm) {
    tidy(models[[nm]], "ran_pars") %>%
      filter(term %in% c("sigma_O","sigma_E")) %>%
      select(term, estimate) %>%
      pivot_wider(names_from = term, values_from = estimate) %>%
      mutate(model = nm)
  }) 
)


get_year_sd_from_summary <- function(m) {
  # Capture summary output as text
  s <- capture.output(summary(m))
  
  # Find the line with "Year (Intercept)"
  idx <- grep("Year \\(Intercept\\)", s)
  if (length(idx) == 0) return(NA_real_)
  
  # Extract numbers from that line
  nums <- regmatches(s[idx[1]], gregexpr("[-+]?[0-9]*\\.?[0-9]+", s[idx[1]]))[[1]]
  
  # The last number is SD, the second-to-last is Variance
  sd_val <- as.numeric(nums[length(nums)])
  
  return(sd_val)
}

year_sd_df <- tibble(
  model = names(models),
 sigma_Year = sapply(models, get_year_sd_from_summary))

metrics_df <- model_cov %>%
  left_join(cAIC_df, by = "model") %>%
  left_join(ran_pars_df, by = "model") %>%
  left_join(year_sd_df, by = "model") %>%  
  full_join(AIC_df, by = "model") 

print(metrics_df)

#Percentage of deviance explained 
fit_mNull <- sdmTMB(eggs0_abu ~ 1, spatial = "off", data = data.eggs, family = tweedie (link = "log"), mesh = bspde)

#Deviance compared to null 
dev_explained_m0    <- 1 - deviance(fit_m0) / deviance(fit_mNull)
dev_explained_m1    <- 1 - deviance(fit_m1) / deviance(fit_mNull)
dev_explained_m2    <- 1 - deviance(fit_m2) / deviance(fit_mNull) 
dev_explained_m3    <- 1 - deviance(fit_m3) / deviance(fit_mNull) 
dev_explained_m4    <- 1 - deviance(fit_m4) / deviance(fit_mNull) 
dev_explained_mSST  <- 1 - deviance(fit_m_SSS_SST) / deviance(fit_mNull) 
dev_explained_mChla <- 1 - deviance(fit_mChla ) / deviance(fit_mNull) 

#Deviance compared to the previous simpler 
dev_explainedm0_m0 <- 1 - deviance(fit_m0) / deviance(fit_m0)
dev_explainedm0_m1 <- 1 - deviance(fit_m1) / deviance(fit_m0)
dev_explainedm1_m2 <- 1 - deviance(fit_m2) / deviance(fit_m1) 
dev_explainedm2_m3 <- 1 - deviance(fit_m3) / deviance(fit_m2) 
dev_explainedm3_m4 <- 1 - deviance(fit_m4) / deviance(fit_m3) 
dev_explainedm2_mSST <- 1 - deviance(fit_m_SSS_SST) / deviance(fit_m2) 
dev_explainedm1_mChla<- 1 - deviance(fit_mChla)/ deviance(fit_m1) 

metrics_df$deviance_null<- 
c(
dev_explained_m0,
dev_explained_m1,
dev_explained_m2,
dev_explained_m3,
dev_explained_m4,
dev_explained_mSST,
dev_explained_mChla)

metrics_df$deviance_prev<- 
c(
dev_explainedm0_m0,
dev_explainedm0_m1,
dev_explainedm1_m2,
dev_explainedm2_m3,
dev_explainedm3_m4,
dev_explainedm2_mSST,
dev_explainedm1_mChla)

SumTable1 <- metrics_df %>% filter(model %in% c("M0","M1","M2","M3","M4"))
print(SumTable1 %>% mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 2))))
```

```{r}
plot_O_pub <- function(prediction, m_code, legend = TRUE) {

  p<- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = coast, fill = "gray60", col = "gray50") +
  geom_sf(data = rivers, col = "steelblue", lwd = 0.5) +
  geom_sf(data = isobath, aes(linetype = factor(Isobaths)),
            color = "gray40", linewidth = 0.4) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c("-100" = "solid", "-200" = "dotdash"), name = "Isobaths (m)") +
    geom_point(
      data = prediction,
      aes(x = lon, y = lat, size = omega_s, color = omega_s),
      alpha = 0.9, shape = 19 ) +
  scale_color_gradient2(
      low = "red", mid = "white", high = "blue",
      midpoint = 0, 
      name = expression(omega[s]),
      breaks = c(-2, 0, 2, 3),        # manual breaks
      labels = c(-2, 0, 2, 3)) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(0.5, 1.8), guide = "none") +
  coord_sf(xlim = c(23.5, 26.4), ylim = c(39.2, 41.1)) +
  labs(x = "Longitude", y = "Latitude", title = m_code) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(23, 26, by = 1))  +theme_bw(base_size = 10) # just a slitly smaller

  if(!legend) {
   p <- p + theme(legend.position = "none")
  }
    print(p)
}
```

### Combined 3D effect plots (Figure 5)
```{r}
#3D conditional effects using visreg - plots have been mased out, rugs added and effects are centered to zero.

#2D conditional effects 
SSSdepth_2d_m4 <-  visreg2d(fit_m4, yvar = "SSS", xvar = "Depth", plot.type = "image") 

# 2. Flatten the x, y vectors and z matrix into a data frame
grid_df <- expand.grid(Depth = SSSdepth_2d_m4$x, SSS = SSSdepth_2d_m4$y)
grid_df$visregFit <- as.vector(SSSdepth_2d_m4$z)

# 3. Define the boundary of your real environmental space from data.eggs
real_points <- st_as_sf(data.eggs, coords = c("Depth", "SSS"), remove = FALSE)
environmental_boundary <- st_convex_hull(st_union(real_points))

# 4. Convert visreg's expanded grid points into a spatial object to check them
grid_points <- st_as_sf(grid_df, coords = c("Depth", "SSS"), remove = FALSE)

# 5. Figure out which grid points fall inside your real data boundary
grid_points$inside <- st_intersects(grid_points, environmental_boundary, sparse = FALSE)[, 1]

# 6. Mask out the ghost areas by setting their predicted fit to NA
grid_df$z_masked <- ifelse(grid_points$inside, grid_df$visregFit, NA)

# 7. Plot the clean, masked surface using ggplot2

                       mid = "white",

       y = "z-SSS") +theme_minimal(base_size = 8)+
     theme(legend.position = "bottom",legend.key.height = unit(0.4, "cm"),legend.key.width = unit(0.4,"cm"))

grid_df <- expand.grid(SSS = TBSSS_2d_m4$x, Acoustic_Biomas = TBSSS_2d_m4$y)
grid_df$visregFit <- as.vector(TBSSS_2d_m4$z)
real_points <- st_as_sf(data.eggs, coords = c("SSS", "Acoustic_Biomas"), remove = FALSE)
environmental_boundary <- st_convex_hull(st_union(real_points))
grid_points <- st_as_sf(grid_df, coords = c("SSS", "Acoustic_Biomas"), remove = FALSE)
grid_points$inside <- st_intersects(grid_points, environmental_boundary, sparse = FALSE)[, 1]
grid_df$z_masked <- ifelse(grid_points$inside, grid_df$visregFit, NA)

TBSSS_2d_m4_masked<- ggplot(grid_df, aes(x = SSS, y = Acoustic_Biomas, fill = z_masked)) +
  geom_raster() +
  geom_contour(aes(z = z_masked), color = NA, alpha = 0.2) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "blue", 
                       mid = "white", 
                       high = "red", 
                       midpoint =0, # Centers the white color
                       name = "f(SSS,TB)", 
                       na.value = "transparent") +
  labs(title = "SSS + TB",
       x = "z-SSS",
       y = "z-TB") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 8)+
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",legend.key.height = unit(0.4, "cm"),legend.key.width = unit(0.4,"cm"))
 
effects_com_M4_masked <- plot_grid(
  SSSdepth_2d_m4_masked, TBdepth_2d_m4_masked, TBSSS_2d_m4_masked,   # use combined plot here
  nrow =1 ,
  label_size = 9,
  label_fontfamily = "Helvetica"
)

effects_com_M4_masked_rugs <- plot_grid(
  SSSdepth_2d_m4_masked + geom_rug(data = data.eggs, aes(x = Depth, y = SSS), 
           color = "gray50", alpha = 0.5, inherit.aes = FALSE, sides ="bl"), # "bl" means bottom and left axes, 
 TBdepth_2d_m4_masked + geom_rug(data = data.eggs, aes(x = Depth, y = Acoustic_Biomas), 
           color = "gray50", alpha = 0.5, inherit.aes = FALSE,sides ="bl"), 
 TBSSS_2d_m4_masked + geom_rug(data = data.eggs, aes(x = SSS, y = Acoustic_Biomas), color = "gray50", 
                                alpha = 0.5,inherit.aes = FALSE,sides ="bl"), nrow =1 ,
 label_size = 9, 
 # labels = c("A","B","C"),
 label_fontfamily = "Helvetica"
)

effects_com_M4_masked_rugs
```
